page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred. Running head at the top; dedication text below; signature and closing lines centred at lower half. No margin notes.

p.i: capite tuo, summo illo rege, Domino ac hærede omnium, Jesu Christo: Cujus gratia, misericordia, & robur te muniant & protegant, tam corpore; quàm Spiritu, ab omnibus inimicis tuis, tam corporalibus, quàm spiritualibus, in sempiternum. Amen.

page.notes: The running head is printed at the top as a heading-like line; the first line of the page is the running title. Some letters in the italic text are worn. "Jesu" and "Id." are printed as shown; "Jd." read as "Id." with a possible [?] where the scan is unclear. The closing name is in small capitals.
